4  FROM SUPPLIED EDIT TO SAVED CANVAS

  AgentChat: edit-diagram / create-diagram / extend-diagram
       |
       v
  ChatDiagramTools
  Resolve reference; pin base; validate selected scope.
       |
       v
  submitStoredDiagramEdit
       |
       v
  submitDiagramEdit
  Validate ASCII, identity claims and source mappings.
  Scoped replacement preserves text outside its ranges.
       |
       v
  createDiagram / reviseDiagram
  Prepare, validate and issue an immutable revision.
       |
       v
  retainDiagramRevision
  Register the revision before publishing its binding.
       |
       v
  MappingDocumentController
  Apply operations -> history checkpoint -> persistence.

  A batch targets one snapshot and commits atomically.
  Variant mode retains a candidate for later use.
  Optional promotion makes it a presentation alternative.

  Separate generator path:
  generateDiagram -> generator.generate -> same submission

  Sources: chatDiagramTools.ts / submitDiagramEdit.ts /
  diagramRevisionStore.ts / mappingDocumentController.ts
